Container.Name: silo-aio
Container.Overview: All-In-One single container release of Silo Server, bundling PostgreSQL 18 (with pgvector), Redis, Meilisearch, and hardware acceleration drivers (Nvidia, Intel, AMD).

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Web interface port for Silo Server UI and API access.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Port
Config.Description: Internal API port for Meilisearch. Only needs to be mapped if accessing search services directly outside the container network.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Persistent host storage path for the PostgreSQL 18 database, Redis cache, local metadata, and Meilisearch indexes.

Config.Name: Media Storage
Config.Description: Host directory containing your Movies and TV Shows shares. Map your primary media share here.

Config.Name: Transcode Cache
Config.Description: Temporary directory for video transcoding buffers. Using /tmp/silo-transcode stores temp files in RAM for maximum speed. If your system has 16GB of RAM or less, change this host path to an SSD path like /mnt/cache/appdata/silo/transcode to prevent high memory usage.

Config.Name: Intel / AMD GPU Device
Config.Description: Passes host graphics device nodes for Intel Quick Sync and AMD VA-API hardware video encoding/decoding. Leave as /dev/dri if using integrated or discrete Intel/AMD GPUs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Required driver capabilities for NVIDIA NVENC/NVDEC hardware transcoding. Set to 'compute,video,utility' or 'all'. Requires the Nvidia Driver plugin to be installed in Unraid.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPU selection. Set to 'all' to use the first available graphics card, or specify your GPU UUID (e.g., GPU-xxxx...). Requires the Nvidia Driver plugin to be installed in Unraid.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encryption key for securing user credentials and session tokens. Auto-generated at startup if left blank.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Master Key
Config.Description: Master key for securing the Meilisearch search API. Auto-generated at startup if left blank and auto-injected into Silo configuration.
